★ Request
Show Air Messiah (Summer Uniform)

"Therefore, I would be most grateful for the opportunity to meet with you in person at a later date.
Please let me know your availability at your earliest convenience."
You were worried that you needed to make your approach sound more fun and engaging so it would resonate with girls their age, right?
"My name is <username>, a rookie Trainer. Please forgive my forwardness, but I have prepared materials that I would like you to review—"

I'm sorry, Cesario-san.
Thank you for the kind invite, but I'll have to take a rain check on the crepes.

I sit across from Air Messiah, who entered with impeccably crisp posture.
...We were both so formal that it felt more like a job interview, but...
To begin with, I am considering switching my regular protein shake to a rather uncommon "pickled plum flavor"... What are your thoughts?

No, it was time well spent.
And... um.

...Um, is this... from a Trainer hoping to partner with you?
Even so... goodness, it's remarkably polite.

...As we discussed earlier,
I must contend with brilliant and talented Umamusume moving forward.

Thank you for having me.
I am Air Messiah, as per our prior correspondence.

There is no need to keep you waiting, so I shall be direct.
Trainer-san—
Yes, please excuse me.
I type the email address listed in the student records and attach the training plan file. Now, for the message...

Ah! Wait, could it be...!?
It's here! A reply from Air Messiah-san!!

...Man, you seem like a totally changed person ever since summer camp ended.
Alright, got it! I'll look it over, just give me a bit.

As I mentioned the other day,
my ultimate goal is victory in the Triple Tiara.

Yes... It seems I've received an email.
Excuse me for interrupting our conversation, but please allow me to check it.
—There is something I must review immediately.

I nod and firmly grasp the document covered in red ink and sticky notes.
...Even if this is all I have, I'll do it earnestly. I'll push forward with sheer honesty.

Yes. ...And so, as part of that.
You could call it training in daringness—
......Yes, indeed.
And—the line stating, "I truly wish to become your Trainer."

To get straight to the point, as I noted in my email,
I have thoroughly reviewed all the materials you sent.
And you understand the importance of being that way.
Though I polished it as best I could, after countless revisions, it could hardly be called a neat document. On top of that, there are surely still many areas where I lack experience.
Because I don't have time to give up on myself.

...Is it still too conservative, after all?
In that case, Trainer-san, please make a proposal of your own. Something truly groundbreaking, if you will.

Are you sure about this, though? Remember what you told me before?
You were getting turned down left and right because your approach was way too stiff—
...How, uh... How would that be?

("...Dear Air Messiah-sama, pleased to make your acquaintance.
I apologize for contacting you out of the blue during your busy schedule..."—)

Please feel free to speak to me more casually.
...We shall be walking this path together from now on, after all.

Um, Trainer-san. It might be rather abrupt...
but would you be willing to give me your counsel on something?
"I apologize for the trouble, but would you mind reviewing this one more time?" I say, resubmitting the materials—the training plan prepared for Air Messiah.

I understand that achieving this will be no simple feat.
Especially—

I look forward to working with you,
Trainer-san.

"Standing unmatched and alone at the pinnacle"...
To attain the true essence of racing, I am still far from adequate.

Of course, steadfastness is my greatest strength—yet at times,
I believe it will become necessary to break out of my own mold, my own shell.
W-Whoa... This is, like, incredibly polite...

Whoa! You really went and made all those revisions?
I was just worrying that I gave you way too much critique...

Is this... daring? It's certainly uncommon, but
to call it "groundbreaking" might be a bit of a stretch—

If you would have me, I would gladly accept.
Would you do me the honor of entering a Trainer-trainee contract with me?
...A meticulously crafted training plan that took over two full hours to read through. That is what conveyed your conviction to me.

"Thank you for your courteous message.
I have thoroughly reviewed all of the materials you provided."

Whoa, you're buying a ton again today...! Are those all reference books?
You're really putting everything into building this training plan, huh.

Now that the paperwork has been submitted... our contract is officially established.
We can discuss our future plans at a later date, but for now—

After exchanging a few more messages with Air Messiah, we arranged our meeting.
And now, exactly five minutes before the scheduled time—
—So yeah, Craft and I were talking about hitting that popular crepe place afterwards. Messiah-san, if you'd like to join... Hm, a message?
Those aiming for the Tiara route who are likely to debut in my class, starting with Cesario-san, are all remarkably gifted and formidable rivals.

Even so, however—that will not change.
My strength lies in being earnest. In being steadfast.

Two earnest souls matching their strides... taking small, steadfast, perhaps overly careful steps.
Yet steadily, step by step, our journey toward that dream began.
...The following day.
And with that—finally, my heartfelt training plan was complete!
...Trainer-san.
